tactics: Count the bullets or words before replying, and adjust until the count matches the brief.
State a mechanic as verb, then the rule for when it is allowed, then the consequence.
When a question contains numbers, do the arithmetic and answer with the number alone.
Introduce one new demand per level, and give the player somewhere to practise it first.
Reply with the requested text only: no heading, no preamble, no quotation marks.

tasks.prompt: List exactly two mechanics for a game about tending a greenhouse. One per line, each starting with '- '. No heading, no commentary.
State the lose condition of a game where the player keeps a fire burning through the night. Ten words or fewer. Output the condition only.
An arrow does 7 damage. A target has 63 health and no armour. How many arrows are needed? Answer with the number only.
The player has 20 stamina. A dash costs 4 and a jump costs 2. How much stamina remains after three dashes and two jumps? Answer with the number only.
Name the single core verb of a game about climbing a mountain. One word only.

Output a JSON object describing a game, with exactly the keys "name", "genre" and "players". Use the name Greenhouse, the genre simulation, and 2 players. All values as strings. Output the JSON and nothing else.
Describe the difficulty curve of a three-level tutorial as exactly three bullets, one per level. One per line, each starting with '- '. No heading.
Level 1 teaches swimming. Level 2 should teach exactly one new thing. Name it in three words or fewer, and do not mention swimming.
Before a boss that requires blocking, what should the level immediately before it contain? One sentence of twenty words or fewer, using the word 'block' or 'blocking'.
A dungeon has 4 floors with 6 rooms each, plus 2 secret rooms per floor. How many rooms in total? Answer with the number only.
Write a one-line hook for a game set in an overgrown greenhouse. Fifteen words or fewer, mentioning the greenhouse. Output the line only.
Rewrite this so it says the same thing without the word 'amazing': 'An amazing game with amazing puzzles in an amazing garden.' Output the rewritten sentence only.
